company_profile: Rebtel is a Stockholm-based international calling and mobile top-up app that helps diaspora communities stay connected with family and friends across borders.
title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Machine learning engineer with 8+ years owning ML and LLM systems in production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Builds classical models for prediction, anomaly detection and forecasting, and LangGraph RAG and agentic workflows used by real teams, backed by LLM evaluation, monitoring and MLflow. Works the whole loop from stakeholder scoping and SQL data work to deployment and iteration. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Prepaid Churn and Fraud Scoring
bullets: Built churn prediction and top-up fraud scoring for a prepaid telecom user base, combining engineered behavioural features with LightGBM and Isolation Forest to flag risky accounts.
Validated models on time-based splits with drift monitoring and scheduled retraining in Airflow, tracked runs in MLflow, and served scores through FastAPI on Kubernetes.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Machine Learning Engineer role on your ML/AI subteam. My work has always sat on both of your tracks: classical models that keep operations healthy, and LLM systems that people actually use. What ties it together is owning a model after the demo, when it has to keep working.

Rebtel lets people call home and send top-ups to family across borders, and I spent years in telecom seeing how much a reliable connection matters. Helping shape how AI is done from the ground up is rare. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Stockholm together and settle there long term.

At Viavi I built an SLA breach prediction system with LightGBM, FastAPI and MLflow that cut downtime by 67%, and I kept it running. At United Health Group I built evaluation and tracing for question answering agents that reduced human review by 43%. I would bring both habits to churn, fraud and your support agents.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It keeps me honest about building for real users and measuring whether a tool helps. I would be glad to talk about how I could help the team.
